evidence_items.explanation: The authors estimate a positive gross margin for the GPT-5 bundle, while finding operating margins near zero before additional revenue-sharing effects. This is material evidence against a categorical denial, but it is an estimate for a particular model period and expense definition, not proof of the full proposition.

evidence_items.publisher: Anthropic, PBC / U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
evidence_items.locator: Note 8, Supplemental Operating Expense Information, footnote (1); Consolidated Statements of Operations, 2025 column
evidence_items.explanation: Audited 2025 revenue of $4,585 million and cost of revenue of $2,773 million imply a 39.5% gross margin. This is substantial retrospective counterevidence under a gross-margin reading, but the filing separately classifies free-access compute and channel-partner costs in sales and marketing and was not public when Zitron wrote.

unresolved_gaps: The claim supplies no accounting basis, preventing a supported or contradicted money assessment under the required rules.
The evidence does not establish a common expense boundary for inference profitability across the labs.
The latest completed annual reporting period is only a proxy for the ongoing state described at publication.
The search located favorable estimates but did not establish a sufficiently complete public financial demonstration available by March 31, 2026.
The later Anthropic filing cannot establish the existence of public proof at the post date, and its gross margin does not include every potentially attributable serving expense.
